visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands holds a dark green rectangular box containing six distinct square brownies. The brownies are decorated with various toppings including a lotus biscuit, Oreo crumbs, golden cereal flakes, and swirls of white and red cream. The lighting is bright and warm, emphasizing the moist and dense texture of the cakes. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of a glass display shelf inside a bakery. Several brownies topped with a smooth, shiny brown glaze are neatly arranged on white ceramic plates. In the background, other desserts and a bouquet of flowers are visible, creating a cozy and professional retail atmosphere. (3) A series of extreme close-ups shows fingers and a gold fork interacting with the brownies. One brownie with a white and pink swirl is broken apart to reveal a dark, moist interior. Another brownie topped with a chocolate-covered hazelnut ball is drizzled with liquid chocolate and then cut with a fork. (4) A woman wearing a white lace-patterned top stands behind a glass counter display filled with various brownie flavors. On the counter, there is a small branded paper bag with a rabbit logo and a decorative floral arrangement. The setting appears to be a clean, well-lit modern pastry shop. (5) The final sequence shows the exterior of the shop. A white sign featuring a golden rabbit silhouette and the text 'BUNNY FLOWER' is mounted on a light gray wall. Large green potted plants frame the entrance, and a decorative floral-style chandelier hangs from the ceiling in the entryway.

The music remains at a consistent volume as a background bed. There are no incidental noises or crowd sounds. (3) The vocal delivery becomes slightly more informative as the narrator lists different ingredients like sea salt caramel and hazelnut. The acoustic guitar continues its steady strumming pattern. The audio clarity remains excellent with high tonal purity. No sound effects are used to punctuate the descriptions. (4) As the narration reaches the promotional details regarding the pop-up event and dates, the speaker's intonation varies slightly to hold attention. The background music maintains its cheerful major-mode tonality. The interplay between the voice and the acoustic guitar is balanced, ensuring clear communication. (5) The narrator provides the shop's name and location with a warm closing statement. The acoustic guitar track continues briefly after the speech ends and then fades out smoothly. The overall audio production is polished and professionally mixed for a broadcast-style presentation.
